digest.component_or_area: tickets-store git maintenance and history reclaim
propositions: Spent ~1 GiB of unreachable ticket-event history must be reclaimed from the tickets store via proven length-aware git fast-export/fast-import history strip and repack/gc to restore filtered pack size below 131,072 KiB (128 MiB) CI gate limit.

The filtered tickets pack has grown to 131,431 KiB, exceeding the 131,072 KiB limit and causing stale-based changes to fail the pack-size verification gate; fresh-main-based changes pass because they accumulate less delta.

All writers must be paused, operator must confirm zero active sessions and stopped rebar-mcp servers, and every pre-rewrite safety gate (workflows disabled, no in-flight reconciler runs, no active locks/gates) must be revalidated before any store mutation.

Ticket 30d3-eaf0-c7a4-497a (diagnostic repair) must be executed and closed with zero repairable-diagnostics fsck receipt before the history rewrite, ensuring the authoritative store is clean before repacking.

Off-repo bundle backups must be created and verified before and after the repair (pre-repair and final pre-rewrite), with exact OID matching and rollback capability, before any ref-pin removal or history rewrite occurs.

After publication, the deterministic first post-rewrite writer must be the rebar.toml identity.enforce_since re-pin vote, executed with REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_DRAIN disabled, as the sole canonical four-commit sequence (CREATE, REVIEW_RESULT, code-review-to-work link, reciprocal work-to-code-review link) before restoring prior settings and re-enabling all writers.
